<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Incentives decline more than 10 percent while retail sales rise 4 percent from March </B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT &#150;</B> General Motors dealers in the United States reported 232,538 total sales in April, a 27-percent increase versus April a year ago.
Solid gains by GM&#146;s lineup of fuel-efficient passenger cars and crossovers powered the gains, led by the best sales month for the Chevrolet Cruze and record sales for the Chevrolet Equinox and GMC Terrain compact crossovers. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Retail sales, those to individual customers, rose 25 percent versus last April with cars and crossovers up 49 percent and 28 percent, respectively.
Retail sales for the Cruze were 180 percent higher than the Chevrolet Cobalt it replaced. The Equinox and Terrain also posted retail sales records, up 53 and 61 percent respectively. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">With gasoline averaging almost $4 per gallon, consumers are beginning to trade in larger vehicles for smaller, more fuel efficient ones. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Recently, rising fuel prices have led many to re-think their vehicle choice,&#148; said Don Johnson, vice president, U.S. Sales Operations. &#147;Because of the investments we&#146;ve made in
fuel-efficiency and global product architectures, the company is well positioned to meet these needs.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">During the first quarter of 2011,
the company&#146;s retail share of the small, compact and compact crossover segments improved by an estimated 3.4 full share points, compared to the first quarter of 2010. Much of this improvement is due to improved availability of the popular
Equinox and Terrain and the launch of the all-new Cruze. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Compared to March, retail sales rose 4 percent though incentive spending decreased
more than 10 percent, Johnson said. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">April deliveries to commercial accounts rose 21 percent &#150; the 13</FONT><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> consecutive month of commercial sales gains. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>GM&#146;s Newest Vehicles Retail Sales Soar 76 Percent in April </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Combined retail sales for vehicles launched since June 2009 &#150; Chevrolet Equinox, Silverado HD, Cruze, Camaro Convertible and Volt; Buick LaCrosse and Regal; GMC Sierra HD and Terrain; and Cadillac
SRX, CTS Wagon and CTS Coupe &#150; jumped 76 percent during April and are up 76 percent for the year through April. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Passenger Cars
</I></B></FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Total sales of GM passenger cars improved 50 percent during April, led by the sale of 25,160 Cruzes and
24,701 Chevrolet Malibus. Retail sales of GM passenger cars climbed 49 percent for the month. The Cruze and Chevrolet Camaro Convertible recorded their highest retail sales since launch. For the year-to-date, retail sales of GM&#146;s passenger cars
were up 49 percent, also led by the Cruze, up 195 percent for the year compared to the Chevrolet Cobalt. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Crossovers </I></B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Chevrolet, GMC and Cadillac brands each set April total and retail sales records for crossover sales, driven by a 49-percent increase in combined
retail sales by the Equinox, Terrain and SRX. The three also set individual April records for retail sales. For the year-to-date, retail sales of GM&#146;s industry-leading crossovers were up 29 percent. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Pickups </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Total combined sales of
Chevrolet Silverado and Avalanche, and GMC Sierra increased 2 percent; with retail sales down 2 percent versus a year ago. For the year-to-date, retail sales for GM&#146;s full-size pickups are up 26 percent, while total sales of 172,070 units
represent a 22-percent increase. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Month-end dealer inventory in the United States stood at about 577,000 units, up about 3,000 units compared
to March and about 149,000 higher than April 2010. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Brand Key Facts: </B></FONT></P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I></I><B><I>Chevrolet: </I></B><I>Chevrolet dealers delivered 169,794 total vehicles in April, a 25-percent increase versus last year. Retail sales

 <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For release: April&nbsp;3, 2010, 10:45 AM EDT </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Cars, Crossovers Drive Chevy April Sales up 25 Percent </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Retail sales
climb 25 percent, driven by demand for Cruze, Equinox and Malibu </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT &#150;</B> With the price of gasoline above $4 a gallon in
many parts of the United States, more customers are choosing Chevrolet&#146;s fuel efficient cars and crossovers. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In April, Chevrolet sold a
total of 169,794 vehicles, for a 25 percent increase in both total and retail sales over the same month a year ago. Driven by consumer demand for fuel efficiency, nearly 40 percent of brand&#146;s total sales in April were from three fuel-efficient
vehicles: the Chevrolet Cruze, Malibu, and Equinox. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Our lineup of gas-friendly vehicles like Cruze, Malibu, and Equinox, Chevrolet
offer drivers more miles per gallon without sacrificing performance, style or value,&#148; said Alan Batey, U.S. vice president, Chevrolet Sales and Service. &#147;Clearly, that is resonating with car buyers today.&#148; </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Fuel economy is especially important for Californian drivers, according to Joe Herold, president of Quality Chevrolet in Escondido, Calif.: </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;With gas as high as $4.50 a gallon in parts of California, the number of miles per gallon is just as important as the monthly payment for many
shoppers,&#148; Herold said. &#147;That demand for fuel economy has made the Cruze one of our most popular models &#150; we sold five times more Cruzes in April than we did the Chevrolet Cobalts last year.&#148; </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Nationally, Chevrolet sold a record 25,160 Cruze compact cars in April &#150; the most compact cars Chevrolet has sold since May of 2008. In April,
retail sales &#150; those to individual customers &#150; were nearly three times higher than Cobalt a year ago. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The four-cylinder Cruze
offers hybrid-like fuel economy &#150; up to 42 mpg highway &#150; without the hybrid price. The Cruze is also attracting customers who want both fuel economy and upscale features: For 2011, nearly one in four Cruze buyers chose a model equipped
with heated, leather seats. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In April, Chevrolet sold a total of 24,701 Malibu midsize cars &#150; up 49 percent from a year ago. Malibu
retail sales are up 8 percent for April and 4 percent for the year compared with 2010 &#150; which was the best year for Malibu retail sales since 2000. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">With the standard 2.4L Ecotec four-cylinder engine and six-speed automatic, the Malibu delivers 33 mpg on the highway. That fuel efficiency helped Malibu become the only midsize car to be named a
&#147;Best Buy&#148; by Consumers Digest three years in a row. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In April, Chevrolet sold a total of 17,067 Equinox &#150; up 42 percent from a
year ago, and the best April sales ever for the compact crossover. </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Equipped with the standard 2.4L four-cylinder Ecotec engine and six-speed automatic, the front-wheel-drive
Equinox delivers 32 mpg highway, better than the Honda CR-V, Toyota RAV4 and the Ford Escape Hybrid. Equinox was named the Best in Class compact SUV in Auto Pacific&#146;s 2010 Ideal Vehicle Awards. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>About Chevrolet </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Founded in
Detroit in 1911, Chevrolet celebrates its centennial as a global automotive brand with annual sales of about 4.25&nbsp;million vehicles in more than 130 countries. Chevrolet provides consumers with fuel-efficient, safe and reliable vehicles that
deliver high quality, expressive design, spirited performance and value. The Chevrolet portfolio includes iconic performance cars such as Corvette and Camaro; dependable, long-lasting pickups and SUVs such as Silverado and Suburban; and
award-winning passenger cars and crossovers such as Spark, Cruze, Malibu, Equinox and Traverse. Chevrolet also offers &#147;gas-friendly to gas-free" solutions including Cruze Eco and Volt. Cruze Eco offers 42 mpg highway while Volt offers 35 miles
of electric, gasoline-free driving and an additional 344 miles of extended range. Most new Chevrolet models offer OnStar safety, security and convenience technologies including OnStar Hands-Free Calling, Automatic Crash Response and Stolen Vehicle
Slowdown. More information regarding Chevrolet models can be found at <U>www.chevrolet.com</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"># # # </FONT></P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Buick Retail Sales Flourish in April, Up 35 Percent </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I>Demand for fuel-efficient vehicles propel Buick&#146;s 19<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> straight month of sales gains </FONT></I></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT

STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> consecutive month of retail sales gains in April, growing 35 percent year over year with total sales up 51 percent. The brand&#146;s sales to individual customers also have increased 45 percent and its

the fastest-growing major automotive brand in the United States,&#148; said Brian Sweeney, U.S. vice president of Buick&nbsp;&amp; GMC Sales and Service. &#147;With more new models coming to our showrooms this year, we expect Buick&#146;s momentum
to continue.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Buick also is the fastest-growing brand among African-Americans, according to a recent Polk report. Buick increased annual
registrations among African-American car buyers by more than 72 percent in 2010 &#150; nearly 20 percentage points higher than its nearest competitor. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Interest in Buick is on the rise among consumers in general. At <U>Main Street in Motion</U>, a touring test-drive event that pits Buick against other brands, exit polls revealed that public opinion of
Buick improved by 125 percent and purchase consideration improved by 65 percent. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Retail sales of <U>LaCrosse</U> increased 5 percent in
April, with total sales up 8 percent. The <U>full-size sedan</U> recently received a five-star overall safety rating in the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration&#146;s New Car Assessment Program. LaCrosse sales are expected to grow even
more this summer with the introduction of the <U>2012 LaCrosse with eAssist&#153;</U>, which is expected to deliver class-leading highway fuel economy of 37 mpg. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">With <U>crossovers</U> gaining in popularity, <U>Enclave</U> momentum continued to grow in April with retail sales up 6 percent and total sales up 14 percent, year over year. One reason for the
Enclave&#146;s sales success is its fuel economy, 24 mpg highway (2WD), which is better than any eight-passenger crossover. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Enclave, a
four-time winner of Consumer Digest&#146;s Best Buy award, has the highest conquest rate of any Buick, with 48 percent coming from non-GM brands. Approximately 40 percent of all Buick buyers come from non-GM brands and 18 percent come from imports.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In April, Buick markets with year-over-year increases included Miami, Houston and Boston. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;It&#146;s pretty amazing,&#148; said Mark Nazaradi, general manager of Williamson Buick Cadillac GMC in the Miami area. &#147;Just about every
Buick buyer we see is trading in a Lexus, BMW or other import brand.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">One year after its launch, demand for <U>Regal</U> continued to
accelerate in April, with retail sales up 19 percent and total sales up 24 percent month over month. The boost reflects increased availability of the all-new Regal CXL Turbo, which accounted for 32 percent of the <U>sport sedan</U>&#146;s retail
sales in April. The turbo&#146;s 2.0-liter direct-injection four-cylinder engine delivers better horsepower and torque than the Acura TSX, and with its manual six-speed transmission, it also delivers better fuel economy with an EPA-rated 32 mpg
highway. </FONT></P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>GMC Retail Sales Thrive in April, Up 23 Percent </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I>Terrain, Acadia, Sierra and Yukon drive GMC to 19<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> straight month of gains </FONT></I></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT </B>&#150; <U>GMC</U> attained its 19</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> consecutive month of retail sales gains in April, surging 23 percent, with total sales up 29 percent year over year. The brand&#146;s sales to individual customers also have increased 31 percent and its
total sales are up 30 percent for the calendar year to date. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Strong demand for professional grade, <U>fuel-efficient trucks</U>,
<U>crossovers</U> and <U>sport utilities</U> continued to bring consumers to GMC dealerships in April,&#148; said Brian Sweeney, U.S. vice president of Buick&nbsp;&amp; GMC Sales and Service. &#147;Terrains, in particular, are moving off of dealer
lots faster than segment and industry averages. More people are discovering how Terrain and Acadia deliver both utility and fuel efficiency.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">With more consumers seeking fuel-efficient vehicles, <U>Terrain</U> achieved a 61-percent increase in retail sales and a 64-percent increase in total sales year over year. The <U>small SUV</U> delivers
segment-leading EPA-rated 32 mpg in highway driving. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Coming to the 2012 Terrain is GMC IntelliLink, a simple-to-use, customizable
infotainment system and expanded wireless capability. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Demand for a <U>fuel-efficient crossovers</U> attracted customers to <U>Acadia</U> last
month, with retail sales up 29 percent and total sales up 42 percent. Acadia offers the best highway fuel economy, 24 mpg highway (2WD), of any eight-passenger crossover SUV. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Acadia and Terrain combined represented 50 percent of GMC&#146;s sales in April, and are in a dead heat for the highest conquest rate. Nearly half of all Acadia and Terrain customers are coming from
non-GM brands. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Even with crossover sales excelling, the demand for <U>Professional Grade</U> work trucks isn&#146;t letting up. The
<U>Sierra</U> lineup&#146;s retail sales grew 8 percent in April, with total sales up 12 percent. Sierra sales were led by its HD models, which were up 22 percent year over year. <U>Sierra 2500HD</U> recently earned <I>Truck Trend
</I>magazine&#146;s &#147;Best in Class&#148; accolade in the work truck category. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I>Truck Trend</I> also named <U>Yukon</U> the &#147;Best
in Class&#148; <U>full-size SUV</U>. In April, Yukon/XL&#146;s combined retail sales were up 5 percent while its combined total sales &#150; retail and fleet &#150; were down 13 percent year over year. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In April, GMC markets with significant year-over-year increases included New York, Phoenix and Chicago. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Fuel efficiency is definitely helping to drive sales of Acadia and Terrain,&#148; said Henry Brown, a GMC dealer in the Phoenix metropolitan area.
&#147;At the same time we&#146;re seeing strong interest in our Denali models. People have been fiscally conservative the last couple of years and are ready to get into a nicer vehicle. Denali gives them the step up they&#146;ve been wanting.&#148;
</FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>Denali</U> is a core brand for GMC, providing a unique blend of Professional Grade capability along with
exclusive styling and premium content. Demand for Denali has more than doubled so far this year, contributing to the 19-month string of GMC sales increases. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;For many of our customers, Denali is a brand of its own. There is nothing else like it on the market,&#148; Brown said. &#147;Denali gives them the comforts of a passenger car in a professional
grade truck. It&#146;s a winning combination.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About GMC </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>GMC</U> has built trucks since 1902, and is one of the industry's healthiest brands. Today GMC is evolving to offer more fuel-efficient trucks and crossovers, including the <U>Terrain small SUV</U> and
<U>Acadia crossover</U>. The new GMC <U>Sierra Heavy Duty pickups</U> are the most capable and powerful trucks in the market. Innovation and engineering excellence are woven into all GMCs, including the <U>Yukon and Yukon XL SUVs</U> and full line
of <U>Sierra pickups</U>. Today, GMC is the only manufacturer offering three full-size hybrid trucks. Details on all GMC models are available at <U>www.gmc.com</U>, on Twitter at @thisisgmc or at <U>www.facebook.com/gmc</U>. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">### </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Contact:
</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Kelly Cusinato </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">313-402-4871

<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:1px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Cadillac U.S. Sales Rise 16 percent in April</B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Cadillac retail sales up 25 percent in April </B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>CTS sales up 29 percent total, 52 percent retail </B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>SRX records 21 straight months of year-over-year sales gains </B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT &#150; </B>Cadillac reported today its total U.S. sales increased 16 percent in April to 13,127 led by the CTS family of luxury sports cars and SRX crossover. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The <U>CTS Sedan</U>, <U>Wagon</U> and <U>Coupe</U> posted total sales of 4,220 in April for a 29 percent increase compared to the same month last year.
CTS retail sales for April rose 52 percent. It was the best April since 2008 for total and retail CTS sales. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>SRX</U> total sales rose 12
percent in April to 4,380. SRX retail sales were up 20 percent. Dramatically redesigned for the 2010 model year, the SRX has posted year-over-year sales gains for 21 consecutive months. It was the best April ever for total and retail SRX sales.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Along with the sales increases, Cadillac was honored in April with three Kelley Blue Book <U>2011 Brand Image Awards</U>, the most by any
brand. Kelley Blue Book named Cadillac winner of Best Exterior Design Brand in the Luxury category as well as Best Interior Design Brand and Best Comfort Brand among all classes. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Cadillac also completed in April its second straight year of customer service training programs with hotelier Ritz-Carlton. This year&#146;s 10-city dealer-meeting tour trained more than 4,000 Cadillac
sales and service personnel. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Cadillac&#146;s success is being driven by great products and a focus on customer service,&#148; said Kurt
McNeil, vice president of Cadillac Sales and Service. &#147;We&#146;re attracting new and returning customers to the dealerships with a line-up that offers distinctive design and outstanding performance. We&#146;re also providing a heightened
emphasis on customer service that we&#146;re confident will pay off with long-term loyalty to the brand.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Cadillac
</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Cadillac has been a leading luxury auto brand since 1902. In recent years, Cadillac has engineered a historic renaissance led by artful
engineering and advanced technology. More information on Cadillac can be found at <U>media.cadillac.com</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">### </FONT></P>
